analysis:
The PR changes only CHANGELOG.md (documentation, no executable code). I read the whole patch across units 0-2 and found no direct security regression. Because it documents many security-relevant behaviors, the next pass should check those claims against the actual source, which is not in this batch.

TB-007/T-041 (prefix cache): the changelog describes faster CPU encode/decode of older attention rows at `balanced` checkpoint precision and Gemma 4 tensor-parallel prefix reuse in memory and in the encrypted SSD tier. It says bytes and refusals are unchanged. The at-rest posture (HMAC names, 30-minute TTL, AES-GCM) is not described as changing. The next pass should confirm that the per-segment encode and the per-row check do not weaken the DBK3 metadata, AAD or nonce derivation. It should also confirm that the new tensor-parallel SSD prefixes are scoped by the same cacheSalt and HMAC lookup tags, and that Qwen's longer prefix reuse, which now goes beyond 32K tokens, keeps the TTL and budget bounds.

TB-002/TB-003 and update and rollback paths (T-013, T-043): the changelog describes cluster self-update and rollback features. These include the cluster service running `darkbloom --version` once, quarantine, `darkbloom update --rollback`, and a follow-rollback mechanism between the two Macs of a pair. The implementation was not supplied. The next pass should verify that hash and signature checks are retained and that the partner-triggered rollback is authenticated over the paired encrypted link.

App Attest (A-015/A-016, T-053/T-057): the `is_supported_false` restart reads a new `app-attest-verified.json` file, which is seeded from `daemon-state.json`. The restart still requires the coordinator to grant App Attest again. The next pass should verify that the local file grants no serving authority and has owner-only permissions.

Other items for later review: the enabled-model filter refusing `load_model` (a positive change); the sandbox installer plan flow (TB-013/T-061: the installer is downloaded and run, with `--plan` before confirmation); and the local log line `App Attest entitlement evidence`, which stays local and is not sent to the coordinator (T-058). The next pass should check what that line contains.

No finding is raised because no supplied code shows a control weakened. needs_deeper_review is set to true because the documented behaviors depend on source files outside this batch.
